name: keystroke-typer-human
title: Keystroke Typer · Human
description: Human-paced keystroke injection: 75-100 WPM drift, periodic and long-word pauses, typo-and-retype, Esc to abort, for paste-blocked input fields.
author: suzune

commands.name: type-text
commands.title: Type Text Like a Human
commands.subtitle: Keystroke Typer · Human
commands.description: Type text with drifting WPM, hesitation before long words and occasional typo-and-retype.

commands.name: type-clipboard
commands.title: Type Clipboard Like a Human
commands.subtitle: Keystroke Typer · Human
commands.description: Type the clipboard content using the human-pacing preferences below.

commands.name: check-accessibility
commands.title: Check Accessibility Permission
commands.subtitle: Keystroke Typer · Human
commands.description: Verify or grant the Accessibility permission required to synthesize keyboard events.

preferences.name: humanMode
preferences.title: Human Pacing
preferences.label: Enable WPM drift, long-word pauses and typos
preferences.description: Turn off to fall back to the fixed-interval engine of the original extension.

preferences.name: wpmMin
preferences.title: Minimum WPM
preferences.description: Lower bound of the per-word typing speed. Standard WPM: 5 characters = 1 word.

preferences.name: wpmMax
preferences.title: Maximum WPM
preferences.description: Upper bound of the per-word typing speed.

preferences.name: longWordLength
preferences.title: Long Word Threshold
preferences.description: Words strictly longer than this many characters may trigger a hesitation pause.

preferences.name: pauseChance
preferences.title: Hesitation Chance (%)
preferences.description: Probability of pausing before a long word.

preferences.name: phraseMin
preferences.title: Words Between Breath Pauses (Min)
preferences.description: After every N words (N sampled in this range) the typer takes a short breath.

preferences.name: typoChance
preferences.title: Typo Chance (%)
preferences.description: Probability per word of hitting a neighbouring QWERTY key, then deleting and retyping the whole word.

preferences.name: focusDelay
preferences.title: Focus Delay (ms)
preferences.description: Time to wait after closing the Raycast window so the previous app regains focus before typing starts.

preferences.name: interval
preferences.title: Typing Interval (ms) [classic mode]
preferences.description: Only used when Human Pacing is off. Delay between two characters.

preferences.name: maxCharacters
preferences.title: Max Characters
preferences.description: Safety cap. 2000 characters at 75-100 WPM takes roughly 4-6 minutes including pauses.

preferences.name: physicalKeys
preferences.title: Use Physical Key Codes for ASCII
preferences.label: Emit real ANSI key codes (strict input detectors)
preferences.description: Emits key codes with correct event.code for ASCII, and temporarily switches to an ABC/US keyboard layout. Chinese characters still use Unicode injection.

preferences.name: clearFirst
preferences.title: Clear Target Field First
preferences.label: Send Cmd+A then Backspace before typing
preferences.description: Only safe when the caret is inside a text field; in a browser body Cmd+A selects the whole page.

preferences.name: pressReturn
preferences.title: Press Return Afterwards
preferences.label: Send Return after typing
preferences.description: Useful for single-line inputs such as chat boxes or search fields.
